planDetail.noFindings: No findings have been raised in this audit.
planDetail.askAbout: Explain audit {{ code }}: what is in scope, how far it has come and what still needs to be done.
planDetail.deleteMessage: The audit, its checklist and its findings are removed, and their open corrective actions are cancelled. The history is kept in the audit log.
planDetail.ownChecklistHint: The certification body uses its own plan. Use a checklist here only if you want to prepare.

external.title: Report and findings from the auditor
external.body: Upload the report you received, and register each finding from it so it is followed up here.
external.raise: Register a finding from the report

internal.planned: Put together the team (with a lead auditor) and the checklist. Then press «Start the audit» on the day.
internal.in_progress: Answer each question in the checklist and link the evidence you saw. Register a finding when something is not in order.
internal.reporting: Write the summary and the overall conclusion, then send the report for approval.
internal.report_review: The report waits for approval by someone who did not write it.
internal.closed: The audit is closed. Follow up the open findings until they are verified.
internal.cancelled: The audit was cancelled. Reopen it if it should be carried out after all.

external.planned: Prepare: share the scope with the auditor and name your contacts. Start the audit when it begins.
external.in_progress: Upload the auditor's report when you receive it and register its findings.
external.reporting: Register the remaining findings and write a short summary for management.
external.closed: The audit is closed. Follow up the findings and keep the certificate up to date.
external.cancelled: The audit was cancelled. Reopen it if it should be held after all.

findings.subtitle: Every finding from internal and external audits, and how far the follow-up has come.
findings.raiseFromAudit: Findings are registered from an audit

findingForm.fixTitle: Could not save. Fill in the title.
findingForm.askEvidence: What counts as good objective evidence for this finding?
findingForm.clauseHint: The requirement that is not met. It is marked as a weak spot on the requirement in Standards.

findingDetail.askAbout: Explain finding {{ code }} and what a good response would look like.
findingDetail.askRootCause: Help me find the root cause of finding {{ code }}, for example with five whys.
findingDetail.ncHint: A nonconformity needs a root cause and a correction before it can be submitted for verification.
findingDetail.noDeviations: This finding is not linked to a deviation.
findingDetail.searchDeviation: Search for a deviation to link
findingDetail.deleteMessage: The finding is removed and its open corrective actions are cancelled.
findingDetail.clauseWeak: This shows that the requirement is weak. It does not count as evidence that it is met.
findingDetail.responseHint: Find the root cause, fix what went wrong now (correction), and prevent it from happening again (corrective action).
findingDetail.decisionHint: An observation or improvement suggestion needs no root cause analysis. Write what you decided to do, and why.
findingDetail.askDecision: Help me decide what to do with finding {{ code }}.
findingDetail.correctiveHint: A short summary. Add the actual work as tasks below, or link the deviation that holds it.
findingDetail.verificationHint: The lead auditor, or someone else with audit rights who did not write the response, checks that the actions are done. Then the finding is closed.
findingDetail.effectivenessHint: Some time after closing, check that the problem has not come back.
findingDetail.actionsHint: Tasks that carry out the corrective action.
findingDetail.actionsInDeviation: The corrective actions are followed up in the linked deviation.
findingDetail.deviationsHint: Link the deviation that handles this finding, or create one with «Create from this».

nc.open: The responsible person finds the root cause and plans the correction. Press «Start the response».
nc.in_progress: Fill in root cause, correction and corrective action, then send the response.
nc.pending_verification: The auditor checks that the actions are done and verifies the finding.
nc.closed: The finding is closed. Check later whether the actions worked.

other.open: Decide what to do with the suggestion and write the decision.
other.in_progress: Write the decision and send it.
other.pending_verification: The auditor reads the decision and closes the finding.
